problems.title: Second Largest Distinct Value
problems.description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return the second largest **distinct** value in it.

If the array has fewer than two distinct values, return `-1`.
hints: Keep the largest and second largest values seen so far.
A value equal to the current largest must not become the second largest.

problems.title: Is Subsequence
problems.description: Return `true` if string `s` is a subsequence of string `t`: `s` can be formed by deleting zero or more characters from `t` without changing the order of the remaining characters.
constraints: Both strings contain only lowercase letters
hints: Walk through t once while advancing a pointer into s on every match.
Check the pointer against s.length() before reading s.charAt(i).

problems.title: Reverse a Subarray
problems.description: Reverse the elements of `nums` between indices `left` and `right` (both inclusive), in place.
hints: Swap nums[left] and nums[right], then move both indices toward the middle.

problems.title: Remove a Value from a Linked List
problems.description: Remove every node whose value equals `val` from the linked list `head`, and return the new head.
hints: A dummy node in front of head means the head is no longer a special case.
Only advance the pointer when you did not remove the next node.
